note: Upstream repository furniture that is a Markdown file but not documentation. The developer source is downloaded whole (upstream .docsignore deliberately not applied), so without this list files like the docs repo's own AGENTS.md and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md are ingested as ordinary pages: they carry valid frontmatter and index lines, and they ship to consumers. One list, three gates - sync (stops re-admission), wiki:lint (catches a tree that already has one) and pack (the release gate: repository furniture must never be published as a documentation page).
